//: Padel rackets as rigid bodies for the ball impact (src/sim/contact/racket.ts). Sources in docs/realism.md. FIP limits: 45.5 cm long, 26 cm wide, 38 mm thick. mass (kg), balance from the butt (m), iCm: moment of inertia about the centre of mass across the face (kg m^2), iPolar: about the long axis (twist). Both fitted so the free-racket apparent COR surface reproduces Viollaz & Viollaz (ISBS 2008): curvature -1.0e-5/mm^2 along the face (iCm 0.0075) and -4e-5/mm^2 across it (iPolar 0.0018) for a 360 g racket. e17: ball-racket COR at 17 m/s relative impact speed and eSlope its loss per m/s (ACOR 0.50 at 17 m/s and 0.39 at 29 m/s at its best point, conventional rackets), clamped to eMin..eMax. friction: sliding friction of the face (static COF of padel faces 0.14-0.93, TWU); tangentialE: how much of the contact point's slip reverses when the ball grips (tuning, tennis-ball order). dwell: contact time (s). twist: fraction of the face's rotation by the end of the contact that turns the ball (tuning). headLength/headWidth: the hitting face as an ellipse from the tip (m).
